posts.author: dave battin
posts.post_subject: Trial shot DCG with a 215 m laser
posts.content_md:
thanks guys! the method is as follows;

coat gelatin onto glass, allow to harden.

dip hardend plates into AMDI/H2O, 15grs./.5liter/10ml soapy water

allow to **AIR DRY**expose .................

now if i could just get the gelatin to stop jumping off the glass! :wall:
